title: CollabAtlas Case Study Entry
description: Schema for validating case study entries in the CollabAtlas collaborative solutions knowledge platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the entry, lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

title.description: Display title of the case study.

tagline.description: Short summary of the case study, max 200 characters.

description.description: Full description of the case study.

domains.description: Domains or fields where this case study is relevant.

collaboration_type.description: Types of collaboration demonstrated in the case study.

scale.description: Scales at which this case study operated.

modality.description: Modalities used in the case study.

maturity.description: Maturity level of the case study documentation.

external_links.description: External links related to the case study.

related_entries.description: IDs of related entries in the atlas.

created.description: Date the entry was created (ISO 8601 date).

last_reviewed.description: Date the entry was last reviewed (ISO 8601 date).

contributors.description: List of contributors who authored or reviewed this entry.

research_method.description: Research methods associated with this case study.

organization.description: Organization where the case study took place.

year.description: Year the case study was conducted.

outcomes.description: Summary of the outcomes and results of the case study.

methods_used.description: IDs of method entries used in this case study.

tools_used.description: IDs of tool entries used in this case study.
